main_text.p: LXVIII. Pro Praxi; 1. Hunc unicum Mediatorem Θεάνθρωπον vera fide agnoscamus: Joh. 3. 16. xvij,3. In sanguine ipsius reconciliationem & pacem quæramus: Rom. 5. 10, 11. Eph. 2. 13, 14, &c. In illo Sponsore nostro ἀντιψύχῳ confidamus: Hebr.7.22. 2 Cor. 5.21. In illo Redemtore liberationem credamus: Job. 19. 25. Eph. 1. 7. In illo Salvatore perfecto unice acquiescamus: Hebr. 7. 24, 25. Act. 4. 12.

2. Tantum illum Prophetam audiamus: Deuteron. 18. 18, 19. cum Act. 3. 22. In ipsius Sacerdotali oblatione, nostri à peccatis purificationem constituamus: Hebr. 9. 13, 14. 1 Joh. 1. 7. & in ejusdem jugi Intercessione, de favore complacentiæ Divinæ plenè perfuasi, precibus nostris frequenter in ejus nomine ad Deum accedamus: 1 Joh. 2. 1. 2. Hebr. 4. 16. Regi nostro spirituali libentes nos subjiciamus: Psal. 2. 6, 10,-12, cx,3. & viventes in Regno Gratiæ, ad Regnum Gloriæ contendamus: Apoc. 3. 21. 2 Tim. 4. 6,-8.

3. Vitam ejus sanctissimam sedulo imitemur: 1 Joh. 3. 3. Eph. 4. 26, 21, 24. Quoad Intellectum, Voluntatem, & Affectus, ei quam proxime conformemur: Col. 2. 3. Matth. 26. 39. Psal. 40. 9. In perpessionibus hujus mundi, toleramus; Hebr. 12. 1, 2. In tentationibus Diaboli, vigilantiam; 1 Petr. 5. 8, 9. & in omnibus adversis, constantiam adhibeamus: 1 Petr. 2. 19,-24. donec ex hac miseriarum valle liberati, in cœlestis Gloriæ domicilium elevemur: Rom. 8. 17,-19.

page.notes: Faint show-through and stains below the text omitted. Greek words transcribed as best read; the second Greek word (ἀντιψύχῳ) is doubtful and marked by its context only.
